purpose: Where documents with the same CR identity (same specification and CR number) sit for the admitted items of the three headroom families, on which the gate's same-identity check is not defined.
status: added after the scores were seen; reads items and gate databases only

definition.sameIdentityDocument: another document with the same non-empty specification and CR number (the join of verify_chain_items.SAME_IDENTITY_PACKS without its pack clause)
definition.packAnchor: counted on the documents the anchor pack lists (pack_member rows of the gate database)
definition.inGold: a same-identity document named in the document field of a gold row; for pack anchors only documents outside the anchor pack count
